VALUES

  ('subfloor_minimum', '500.00', 'Subfloor Minimum ($)', 'Minimum charge for subfloor on Rainier projects (0 = no minimum)', 'pricing')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  label = VALUES(label),
  description = VALUES(description),
  category = VALUES(category);
